output.summary: Agency spend growth is mostly volume (77%) rather than price (23%), and the rate rise follows the wage-index escalator. Vacancies and resignations were rising well before St. Brennan's opened, and only 19 of 98 known leavers went there. Evidence points to a reinforcing loop: agency use shifts charge and orientation work onto permanent RNs, and resignations follow about two quarters later. The 4 West pilot against matched units supports this. The 2025 bonus did not hold vacancies down. The CFO plan would remove the differentials that reward the workers carrying the load, so it is harmful. Extend the 4 West model to the high-agency units, and treat agency-rate renegotiation as secondary. The falls link is confounded by acuity and patient age.
